name: Tool — Web search (Bing grounding)
summary: BingGroundingTool inside a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed.
description: Not supported: the Foundry Responses API rejects agents with the bing_grounding tool when the orchestrator model uses the {conn}/{deployment} BYOM prefix. Verified live 2026-07-14 against ai-gateway-pe-testing.
notes:
BYOM does not work with Bing grounding.

Server error verbatim:

> The following tools are not supported with BYO model: bing_grounding. Please remove these tools or use a standard model deployment.

Bing grounding is also absent from the docs' BYOM-supported tools list: learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
